fact: The document, signed at Monrovia on 15 December 2025, presents the launch of Liberia's third-generation NSDS III for 2026-2030 as its Foreword states, though chapter 6 also says activities proceed once the LISGIS Board approves it.
The first strategy, NSDS I 2008-2013, is stated as having guided post-war recovery of the statistical system; that period has ended.
PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists a strategy as being designed or awaiting adoption: national strategy for the development of statistics.
